players.label: S
players.job: Snap it back to the punter, then get your head up. You are the middle of the coverage, so run straight down the field at the returner.

players.label: RGD
players.job: Hold your gap. Nobody comes through you. After the kick, get downfield and take the middle of the field.

players.label: LGD
players.job: Protection comes first. Punch the rusher inside and keep him off the punter. When the ball is away, release and fill the middle.

players.label: RT
players.job: Block first, then go. Once the ball is gone you are coverage. Keep outside leverage and turn the returner into your help.

players.label: LT
players.job: Block the man over you for two counts so the punter is safe, then release and cover. Stay outside the returner and squeeze him back inside.

players.label: RG
players.job: Same as the other gunner. Get off the line, get downfield fast, and be the first man to the returner. Do not run past the ball.

players.label: LG
players.job: You are the first one down there. Release outside, beat the man trying to hold you up, and get to the returner before he starts upfield. Stay in your lane.

players.label: RW
players.job: Seal the edge, then cover. Once you release, stay wide. If he gets outside you there is nobody behind you.

players.label: LW
players.job: You are the edge of the wall. Nobody gets around you to the punter. Block first, then release outside and keep the returner in front of you.

players.label: PP
players.job: You are the last man before the punter. Check the count, call the protection, and block anybody who comes free. Then get downfield.

players.label: P
players.job: Catch it, two steps, get it off. After the kick you are the safety, so stay behind the ball and be ready to make the tackle.

players.label: RW
players.job: Seal the edge on the side the protector is breaking to. Your block is the play.

players.label: LW
players.job: Cross behind the punter like you are taking the ball. Sell it hard, because the more they chase you the more room the protector has.

players.label: PP
players.job: The snap comes to you, not the punter. Sell the toss back, then break the other way and get the first down. Take what is there.

players.label: P
players.job: Sell it. Fake the catch, fake the handoff to the wing crossing, and keep your eyes downfield so nobody reads you.

players.label: LJ
players.job: Hold their gunner up at the line. Get hands on him, slow him down, keep him from running free. Every second you buy is a yard for the returner.

players.label: RJ
players.job: Same on your side. Body him, redirect him, do not let him release clean.

players.label: PR
players.job: Catch it first, then run. Call for the fair catch if they are on top of you. Get north and south — do not run sideways.

players.label: LJ
players.job: Hold their gunner up at the line so he cannot get down the field clean.

players.label: RJ
players.job: Get hands on him and slow him down. Buy the returner time.

players.label: PR
players.job: Catch it first. Only then think about running. Fair catch is always the right call if they are already there.

players.label: R5
players.job: Run straight at the ball. Stay in your lane, keep your shoulders square, and make the tackle. Do not run around blocks — run through your lane.

players.label: R4
players.job: Nothing gets outside you. Stay wider than the returner the whole way. If he breaks out, that is on you. Squeeze him back to the middle.

players.label: R3
players.job: Beat your blocker and turn the returner inside. You are the one who makes him choose, so get there fast and get skinny.

players.label: R2
players.job: Fill the gap between contain and the ball. Stay a step behind the front so you can see it, then close on whichever side he picks.

players.label: R1
players.job: Run straight at the ball. Stay in your lane, keep your shoulders square, and make the tackle. Do not run around blocks — run through your lane.

players.label: L1
players.job: Run straight at the ball. Stay in your lane, keep your shoulders square, and make the tackle. Do not run around blocks — run through your lane.

players.label: L2
players.job: Fill the gap between contain and the ball. Stay a step behind the front so you can see it, then close on whichever side he picks.

players.label: L3
players.job: Beat your blocker and turn the returner inside. You are the one who makes him choose, so get there fast and get skinny.

players.label: L4
players.job: Nothing gets outside you. Stay wider than the returner the whole way. If he breaks out, that is on you. Squeeze him back to the middle.

players.label: L5
players.job: Run straight at the ball. Stay in your lane, keep your shoulders square, and make the tackle. Do not run around blocks — run through your lane.

players.label: K
players.job: You are the last man. Stay behind everyone, never pass the ball, and make the tackle if he gets through. If you miss, he scores.

plays.name: Kickoff — Cluster Speed
plays.lineLabel: FREE KICK LINE — INSIDE THE NUMBERS

plays.name: Kickoff — Cluster 10-Play
plays.lineLabel: FREE KICK LINE — INSIDE THE NUMBERS

players.label: R4
players.job: Widest man away from the kick. If they get it and try to bring it back this way, you are the edge.

players.label: R3
players.job: Cover your lane. Stay in it even though the ball is on the far side.

players.label: R2
players.job: Get downfield fast. If they recover it, you are the one who stops the return.

players.label: R1
players.job: The kick is going the other way. Sprint down and cover in case they come up with it — you are the tackler, not the recoverer.

players.label: K
players.job: Drive it into the ground so it takes two big bounces. No pop-ups, they are illegal. Get it past ten yards and give our guys a chance at it.

players.label: L1
players.job: This one is coming to you. It has to travel ten yards before we can touch it, so time your run and arrive as it crosses. Take it in the air if you can. If you cannot, fall on it and cover up.

players.label: L2
players.job: Same as the man beside you. Do not touch it early or we lose it. Get there as it crosses ten, and win the ball.

players.label: L3
players.job: Third man at the ball. If the first two miss it, it is yours. Fall on it — do not try to pick it up and run.

players.label: L4
players.job: You are not recovering it. Get in the way of the first man trying to reach it so our guys can.

players.label: L5
players.job: Block the man closest to where the ball is going. Buy our recover men one extra step.

players.label: L6
players.job: Widest man on the kick side. Nobody gets around you to the ball.

players.label: H5
players.job: Short kick is yours. Do not back up into your own returner.

players.label: H4
players.job: Same as the others. Hands up, eyes on the ball, and if it clears you go find someone to block.

players.label: H3
players.job: You are in the middle. Short kick is yours. If it is deep, turn and block.

players.label: H2
players.job: Front line. Watch for the short kick, and if it goes over you turn and get on the man in front of you.

players.label: H1
players.job: If the ball comes short and low, it is yours. Catch it, do not let it bounce, and get to the sideline.

players.label: RR
players.job: If it is yours, catch it and go. If it is his, get in front of him and block the first man you see.

players.label: LR
players.job: Catch it clean, then pick a side and go. One cut, then straight. Do not dance.

players.label: H1
players.job: Front line. Short kick is yours to catch.

players.label: H2
players.job: Hands up. If it clears you, turn and block.

players.label: H3
players.job: Middle of the front. Catch anything short, block anything deep.

players.label: H4
players.job: Short kick is yours. Eyes on the ball the whole way.

players.label: H5
players.job: Same job. Do not turn your back on the ball.

players.label: LR
players.job: Catch it, one cut, get north. Trust the wall.

players.label: RR
players.job: Yours or his — either catch it or lead him. Do not both go for it.

glossary.text: — the strip of field you are responsible for. Stay in it. Eleven men in eleven lanes means there is nowhere for the returner to go.
— go straight at the ball carrier through your lane.
— stay wider than the ball carrier so he can never get outside you.
— beat your blocker and turn the ball carrier back inside toward help.
— the space between contain and the ball. You fill whichever side he picks.
— the last man back. Never pass the ball. If he beats you, it is a touchdown.
— on punt, the man split out wide whose only job is getting to the returner first.
— getting your hands on their gunner at the line to slow him down.
— the front line on a kick return. If the ball comes short, it is theirs to catch.
— on an onside kick, the men whose job is winning the loose ball. It has to travel ten yards first.
— block the other team away from the ball so our recover men can get to it.
— catches the kick and runs it back. Catching it clean matters more than the return.
— the last blocker in front of the punter. He makes the calls.
— snaps the ball back to the punter, then covers.
— the man on the edge of the punt formation who seals the outside.
— block first, then run downfield and make the tackle.
— keep the rusher off the punter. Nothing matters more until the ball is gone.
— you do not get the ball. Your job is making them think you do.
— 165 lbs or more. On special teams he has to line up on the front two lines or the line of scrimmage, and he cannot fake a punt.
